verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs include an API reference for the AMP REST endpoints (POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id}, POST /resume), listed in llms.txt. Nothing in the evidence shows it is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground console, runnable examples in the API reference, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
